projects.title: Stay4Dentist Platform
projects.description: Platform for Community of Clinical Dental Internships
projects.longDescription: In this project, I worked as a WordPress Developer responsible for building and extending custom functionalities for directory and eCommerce-based platforms. I customized and enhanced plugins such as Directorist and WooCommerce to meet specific business requirements, implemented advanced features using PHP, JavaScript, AJAX, and WordPress hooks, and developed custom plugins where needed. I handled complex logic related to user metadata, dashboard workflows, chat context handling, and dynamic pricing modifications. Additionally, I optimized performance, improved security practices, and ensured responsive, scalable solutions across all devices. My role required deep problem-solving, backend development, and close collaboration with design and content teams to deliver reliable and maintainable systems.
features: Custom plugin development to support unique business workflows
Advanced customization of Directorist and WooCommerce functionality
AJAX-based dynamic features (live chat context handling, real-time updates)
Custom dashboard enhancements and profile management logic
Secure user meta data handling and protection against empty overwrites
Dynamic pricing modifications and checkout customizations
Third-party API integrations for external data synchronization
Performance optimization (query improvements, asset control, script optimization)
Responsive design adjustments for cross-device compatibility
Bug fixing and backend troubleshooting in production environments
WordPress hooks (actions & filters) implementation for scalable architecture

projects.title: Nabra Project - University Senior Project
projects.description: Voice-recognition reading and hearing assessment system with data visualization
projects.longDescription: The Nabra Project is a comprehensive senior university project combining UI/UX design, Flutter Web frontend, and a PHP backend. The system enables educators to efficiently assess students' reading and hearing abilities through interactive modules. It features voice-recognition-based reading assessments, auditory-image matching for hearing tests, secure storage of results, and intuitive data visualizations. Role-based access ensures user privacy, while email-verified password reset functionality adds a layer of security.
features: Secure database storage of assessment results
Role-based access control for educators and students
Graphical data visualization of test results
User authentication and secure password reset via email

projects.title: Driving Exam Test App
projects.description: Flutter-based mobile app simulating the official driving ministry exam with progress tracking and text-to-speech support
projects.longDescription: The Driving Exam Test App is a cross-platform mobile application built with Flutter and Hive DB that simulates the official driving ministry exam. It allows users to practice multiple-choice questions across different exam levels, track their progress, and review mistakes. The app includes a text-to-speech feature to assist users who have difficulty reading, provides immediate feedback by showing correct answers after each exam, and allows users to revisit incorrectly answered questions to improve learning outcomes.
features: Progress tracking with Hive local database
